d: Magnificent temple erected at Belo, festively adorned. Gold in the sanctuary at the foot of the simulacrum of Belo; Magi who prostrate and bow worship; Ministers arranged outside the sanctuary, and prostrated; Gold in the act of heavenly vision.
Open the doors, the scene is filled with Babylonians of the sexes, strangers, Donzelle; all bring offerings and arrange themselves; then we sing the following:
Royal Guards, Satrapi, Princes, Captains who precede Semiramide, who appears with Azema and Mitrane, accompanied by Princesses and Damigelle with rich gifts to be offered to Belo. Slaves.
Gold.
Arsace, two slaves with a closed box.
Gold, coming, and Arsace.
Arsace; indi Assur; Followed with it, which remains in the bottom.
Atrium in the palace.
Hanging gardens. Semiramide sitting in a flowered berceau. Young Citalists and Donzelles in various groups try to distract her, joke around her; it is mixed with the sound as follows:
Mitrane, with papyrus, and Semiramide.
Semiramide, and Arsace.
Assur with Magi and Oroe.

Magnificent place in the palace with a view of Babylon. Throne to the right. To the left vestibule of the superb Mausoleum of King Nino. The Royal Guards precede the pump and arrange; then the Satraps with their Following; Oroe with the Magi and Ministers who carry an altar. Idreno, Assur, Arsace with their own courting happen; to the end Semiramide with Azema and Mitrane and Dame and Schiavi. The People are distributed in the bottom and between the columns; the march is alternated by the following:
Atrium, mitrane, royal guards, arbates.
Semiramide and Mitrane, Damigelle back.
Semiramide, and Assur.
Inside the sanctuary, Magi in adoration, Gold precedes Arsace, accompanied by the Magi who advance religiously.
Apartments in Semiramide. Azema and Mitrane.
Idrenus and sayings, in choirs of Donzelle, of Grandi and Indians.
Semiramide and Arsace.
Remote part of the palace, next to Nino's mausoleum. Assur.
Satrapi from various parts, and Assur.
Mitrane, Arbate with Guards.
Underground interior of Nino's mausoleum. The urn containing Nino's ashes is in the middle. The Magi descend; some are armed with daggers; they advance by declaring the following:
